newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-RAPE CHARGE AGAINST SOCCER STAR KLUIVERT DROPPED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAPE CHARGE AGAINST SOCCER STAR KLUIVERT DROPPED.

text.p: Dutch soccer star Patrick Kluivert will not be prosecuted over an accusation of rape brought against him last month, the Amsterdam Public Prosecutor's office said on Friday.

"The Public Prosecutor has decided not to press charges against Kluivert and three of his friends. There was insufficient evidence to substantiate the rape charge against Kluivert and his friends," a short statement said.
Amsterdam police confirmed in June that they were investigating rape charges made against the Dutch international striker and three friends by a 20-year-old woman.
Kluivert, 20, signed a four-year deal in February to move from Ajax Amsterdam to AC Milan.
In May last year he was convicted of causing death by dangerous driving. He was ordered to perform 240 hours of community service and received a three month jail sentence, suspended for two years.
